notes.questionStem: Consider the following statements regarding the new railway line in Mizoram: (i) It connects Bairabi with Sairang. (ii) The total length of the new railway line is 101 kms. (iii) The project is divided into four sections – Bairabi-Hortoki, Hortoki-Kawnpui, Kawnpui-Mualkhang, and Mualkhang-Sairang. (iv) The Commission of Railway Safety (CRS) has recently approved the opening of the railway line from Hortoki to Sairang in Mizoram. Which of the above statements are correct?

checkedSource.label: Ministry of Railways / PIB, one-year report

notes.sourceFacts: The report says the 51.38 km line was inaugurated on 13 September 2025 and records the Sairang–Silchar passenger service inaugurated in January 2026.
notes.limitation: The later anniversary report does not verify every engineering or CRS statement in the 2025 exam question.

exam.paperId: Old_Questions/Direct_2025-2027/MCS Combined 2025 Preliminary Exam Paper-I Series-A..pdf

notes.questionStem: Consider the following statements regarding the Mizoram Universal HealthCare Scheme (MUHCS): (i) For Contributory Beneficiaries under the Standard Plan, a Premium of Rs. 5000 per family per year allows family to get benefit of 8,00,000/- per family per year in Semi-Private (shared) Ward. (ii) No contribution from AB PM-JAY beneficiaries is required. (iii) Provisional Employees under the Government of Mizoram will have to pay monthly contribution of Rs. 100 for General Ward. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?

checkedSource.label: Mizoram State Health Care Society, MUHCS 2.0 enrolment notice

notes.sourceFacts: Notice covers policy year 2026–27 effective 1 April 2026; lists annual enrolment contribution options ₹2,500/₹5,000/₹10,000 and up to ₹5 lakh per family.
notes.limitation: A dated policy-year description only. It does not say enrolment is still open or give personal eligibility/coverage advice.
